The source writes rho_Psi=|Psi_0|^2 m_psion c^2 and labels result kg/m^3. If Psi_0 literally has declared m^-3 and m_psion is mass, RHS has kg m^-4 s^-2, not kg/m^3. findings.finding: The implementation explicitly sets alpha_TGL=alpha_GR*(1+ALPHA2_MIGUEL*z_lens), with ALPHA2_MIGUEL=0.012 literal. It computes its correction by construction, sets consistent_with_gr=True, and labels lens results is_real_data=False. This is a positive historical deflection prescription, not a derivation from Psi(r), metric potentials, matter profile and boundary conditions, and not the modern runtime beta calibration.

The code obtains theta_E from 4 pi (sigma_v/c)^2 D_ls/D_s using approximate linear-redshift distances and fixed H0=70, then creates mu=theta_E/R on a grid. The round-trip square/root processing of that generated array does not fix a physical Psi amplitude or demonstrate the lens field equations. No code was run.

NFW in the Claude text appears as an alternative mass model (909-912), not a solved Psi profile.
